args.question: Deleting will move emails to Trash (Gmail permanently erases Trash after 30 days). What exactly should I delete?
args.reason: "All my emails" could mean just the Inbox, everything in the mailbox including Sent and archived mail, or only what's visible on screen — and deleting the wrong scope loses real data.
options: Only my Inbox (all conversations currently in Inbox)
Everything in the entire mailbox (All Mail — Inbox, archived, Sent, all labels)
Just the emails visible on this screen right now

content: This is a big, irreversible-ish step, so I want to confirm the scope before touching anything. In Gmail, "delete" moves messages to Trash, where they're permanently erased after 30 days.
